title: Exploring a Song
description: Listen to a song and put words on what it does to you: name the four things you can like in a hit (the singer, the music, the melody, the lyrics), grade your taste on the ladder that runs from "I can't stand it" to "I'm mad / crazy about it" and keep the -ing form after fond of, keen on and mad about, tell the topic of a song from its message and prove a singer's feelings (sadness, hope, fear, determination, jealousy, pessimism) with the words that carry them, express ability, possibility, permission, obligation and prohibition with the modals can, can't, must and mustn't — base form, no -s, no do — and never read mustn't as "it isn't necessary", hear the one sound that separates the two words of a minimal pair and sort the [ou] of home from the [ei] of name behind their spellings, then paraphrase a sentence built on a metaphor, with the words of the lesson: faith, fate, immortality, memory, sorrow, soul, eternity, stardom, superstar status, prowess, convene, mortgage and renown
